news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals running back Chase Brown will face the Tennessee Titans in Week 8. Brown found himself in a split backfield after struggling to succeed in Week 5. Coming out of the team's Week 6 bye, Brown dominated touches out of the backfield. The back handled 11 carries for 39 yards and caught four passes on five targets. news.analysis: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.
news.contents: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.title: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker caught two of five targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Green Bay Packers. Quarterback Bryce Young didn't have a ton of time to get through his progressions on Thursday, and Carolina's passing game struggled as a result. Fortunately for owners, Coker came through late in the fourth quarter on a 26-yard catch-and-run that he cashed in for his third touchdown of the season -- tying a career high. news.title: Jalen Coker Stays Relevant with Late Touchdown
